# Code of conduct

Treat contributors respectfully. Critique code and ideas, not people. Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing and disclosure of private information are unacceptable.

Keep discussions relevant and constructive. Respect confidentiality, licenses and attribution. Report misconduct privately to creator@localzet.com with links and the minimum necessary evidence; do not publish private correspondence.

Ivan Zorin (localzet) maintains these rules and may remove abusive content, restrict participation or close disruptive discussions. Decisions should be proportionate and protect the people involved. Good-faith reports are not grounds for retaliation.
